values.description: Adapting policy behavior after tool or API errors to recover from deployment failures.

values.label: Retrieval and model-editing adaptation
values.description: Updates deployed models through retrieval augmentation or targeted editing instead of full retraining.

values.label: Supervised fine-tuning
values.description: Updates a pretrained model by imitating curated demonstrations before or during alignment operations.

values.label: Production policy freezing
values.description: Freezing deployed policies and allowing updates only after offline or controlled testing.

values.label: Human-escalated policy correction
values.description: Using human review and supervision to steer or adjust deployed policy behavior after observed issues.

values.label: MLOps-integrated refresh workflow
values.description: Integrating deployment monitoring, feedback collection, and recurring model refreshes into repeatable operational pipelines.

values.label: Distributed-aware metric monitoring
values.description: Metrics account for cross-rank aggregation, stragglers, and memory imbalance during distributed training.

values.label: Serving-time computation reuse
values.description: Reuse serving-generated intermediate computations during training to reduce repeated forward-pass work.

values.label: Fixed-base continuously learned adapter
values.description: Update a LoRA adapter continuously while keeping the base model fixed.

values.label: Reversible adapter updates
values.description: Swap in new adapters and revert them when operational or behavioral problems occur.

values.label: GPU-backed inference serving
values.description: Use accelerator-backed serving to meet deployed model latency and throughput requirements.

values.label: Quantized or distilled model serving
values.description: Reduce serving resource requirements through quantization or knowledge distillation while preserving alignment.

values.label: Request batching
values.description: Batch inference requests to improve aggregate serving throughput.

values.label: Constrained or conservative policy updates
values.description: Limit policy changes or enforce safety constraints during learning to reduce catastrophic degradation.

values.label: Policy-managed warm pool
values.description: Serving infrastructure maintains a warm pool whose pre-warming behavior is controlled by a learned policy.

values.label: Temporal and user-context serving features
values.description: Supplying temporal patterns and user context as policy inputs for serving-time prediction.

values.label: Multi-model endpoint serving
values.description: Consolidating multiple policy models behind one serving endpoint.

values.label: Training-serving process co-location
values.description: Place training and serving processes together to support faster online updates.

values.label: Rapid serving-to-training data transfer
values.description: Feed serving data quickly to a separate training cluster rather than updating serving servers directly.

values.label: On-device edge inference placement
values.description: Running the deployed policy directly on edge devices under device compute and storage constraints.

values.label: Lower platform total cost of ownership
values.description: A reported economic effect of selecting the managed platform.

values.label: Higher developer productivity
values.description: A reported productivity effect of the selected RL platform approach.

values.label: Model freshness
values.description: Outcome in which deployed models remain current with new information and feedback.

values.label: Rapid adaptation to streaming data
values.description: Outcome in which continual updates let an agent adapt faster than periodic retraining permits.

values.label: Retraining cost and time burden
values.description: The computational and resource burden that limits frequent full retraining.

values.label: Repeated-feedback constraint violations
values.description: Additional error-recovery rounds improve recovery while increasing severe constraint violations.

values.label: Parameter-efficient update efficiency
values.description: Uses adapter-based updates to reduce compute and memory burden for frequent production adaptation.

values.label: Reduced fine-tuning cost
values.description: Lowers the financial cost of post-deployment model updates relative to full retraining.

values.label: Repeated forward-pass computation
values.description: Outcome in which conventional separation causes serving computations to be repeated during training.

values.label: Near-real-time model updates
values.description: Outcome enabled by tightly integrated training, serving, and computation reuse.

selected_clusters.name: Policy Experimentation Method
selected_clusters.description: Which offline, online, hybrid, or simulation method evaluates policy changes before adoption?

values.label: Offline RL for constrained environments
values.description: Use offline RL when online interaction is dangerous, costly, or legally restricted.

values.label: Online or hybrid experimentation
values.description: Use online or hybrid methods when safe experimentation is possible but logged data is limited.

values.label: Nonrepresentative-log offline RL
values.description: Use offline RL despite nonrepresentative logs or poorly defined rewards; explicitly rejected as unreliable.

values.label: Batch-constrained deep Q-learning
values.description: Offline learning constrains value updates to the support of a fixed dataset to limit extrapolation risk.

values.label: Conservative Q-learning
values.description: Offline value estimation is deliberately conservative to reduce overoptimistic production policies.

values.label: Pairwise LLM feedback scoring
values.description: Using pairwise LLM judgments converted through Bradley–Terry scoring to guide feedback optimization.

values.label: Ray-based RL framework
values.description: Using Ray as the framework for rapidly starting and scaling reinforcement-learning workloads.

values.label: Amazon SageMaker RL platform
values.description: Using managed Amazon SageMaker RL services to move reinforcement-learning development into production-scale workloads.

values.label: Conservative offline objective
values.description: Using conservative objectives and regularization to limit offline overfitting and risky policy behavior.

selected_clusters.name: Monitoring Governance and Explainability
selected_clusters.description: Which governance and transparency model makes production-agent monitoring decisions accountable, interpretable, and compliant?

relations.reading: Choices on Monitoring Governance and Explainability limit the options available on Continuous Behavioral Observability
relations.rationale: s23_p10 ties explainability, accountability, and bias governance requirements to how deployed behavior is monitored and audited.

values.label: Ethical monitoring framework
values.description: Guides production monitoring and model governance through explicit ethical principles addressing bias and unsafe behavior.

values.label: Explainable monitoring decisions
values.description: Provides mechanisms that make model decisions and monitoring judgments understandable and auditable to stakeholders.

values.label: Transparent decision-making
values.description: Requires stakeholders to understand decision rationale rather than treating monitoring and model behavior as a black box.

values.label: Regulatory accountability controls
values.description: Uses formal accountability and fairness controls to satisfy evolving AI governance and compliance expectations.

values.label: Black-box decision-making
values.description: Leaves production decisions opaque to stakeholders and auditors.

values.label: Ongoing bias monitoring
values.description: Continuously checks deployed decisions for bias introduced by feedback, annotation, or model behavior.

values.label: Cross-functional monitoring governance
values.description: Joint interpretation of technical drift, domain changes, and business impact by ML, operations, and domain stakeholders.

values.label: Business-impact monitoring integration
values.description: Linking monitoring to analytics and reporting dashboards for business, safety, accuracy, and satisfaction outcomes.

values.label: Unsafe production behavior
values.description: Unsafe deployed behavior that governance, explainability, and bias controls seek to reduce.

values.label: Reputational risk from opaque decisions
values.description: Loss of trust and reputation caused by unintelligible or unauditable production decisions.

values.label: Human-value alignment
values.description: Alignment of production behavior with safety, harmlessness, context awareness, and human values.

dropped_dimensions.rationale: Dropped because Reward Construction and Specification primarily concerns defining or changing reward functions and objectives during system design or training. Although reward defects are monitored after deployment, the dimension's values are not principally alternative architectural decisions for production monitoring infrastructure.

Dropped because Optimization and Anti-hacking Intervention is predominantly about training-time optimization constraints, reward shaping, and prevention interventions. These choices are outside the central scope of post-deployment monitoring infrastructure; runtime containment is captured more directly by Runtime Safety Shielding (17).

Dropped because Dataset Mixing and Retention Strategy mainly concerns training-data refresh, continual learning, and feedback-data composition. While data retention can support monitoring, this dimension does not primarily represent alternative architectural decisions for observing and responding to deployed RL-agent behavior.
